newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $104/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $104/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers steady to $1.00 per cwt lower on a live basis, heifers not established, USDA said. Dressed basis sales steers and heifers $1.00-$2.00 lower.
Buyer inquiry fairly good, seller interest mixed. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs 64.00, few 63.75; Dressed basis 103.00, few 104.00, ** few 102.00. ( weighted average 103.09). Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 103.00. Confirmed- 3,000 Last Week - 79,600 Last Year - 38,900 Wk To Date- 7,600 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 105,800 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 41,300
